mapper.select: select min(id) from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status='active' having count(*)=1
with active as (select min(id) id from cm_user_goal where user_id=#{userId} and status='active' having count(*)=1) select g.id from cm_user_goal g join active on active.id=g.id for update
select min(id) from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published' having count(*)=1

select e.id error_record_id,e.user_id,e.goal_id,sq.question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.id session_question_id, a.id attempt_id,s.session_type,e.status error_status,e.status_reason,cast(e.detected_time as text) detected_time,a.is_skipped skipped, sq.evidence_group_key,sq.exam_subject_id,sq.difficulty_snapshot,sq.estimated_seconds_snapshot,sq.presentation_snapshot::text, sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,sq.ai_rubric_snapshot::text ai_rubric_snapshot,aa.answer_data::text, coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',kp.id::text,'name',kp.syllabus_title) order by kp.sort_order,kp.id) from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(sq.knowledge_snapshot->'items') = 'array' then sq.knowledge_snapshot->'items' else '[]'::jsonb end) frozen join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=(frozen->>'knowledgePointId')::bigint and kp.syllabus_version_id=goal.syllabus_version_id and kp.status='0' and kp.del_flag='0' where not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=kp.id and child.status='0' and child.del_flag='0')), '[]'::jsonb)::text current_knowledge_points from cm_error_record e join cm_user_goal goal on goal.id=e.goal_id join cm_question_attempt a on a.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id join cm_learning_session s on s.id=sq.session_id left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type in ('initial_diagnosis','daily_task','task_test','self_practice','simulation','past_paper_practice','past_paper_exam') order by e.detected_time desc,a.id desc,e.id desc

select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,s.status,count(sq.id)::int total_count, count(a.id) filter(where a.status='submitted')::int submitted_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.goal_id=#{goalId} and s.session_type='correction' and s.status in ('created','in_progress','submitted','settling') group by s.id

select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,s.status,count(sq.id)::int total_count, count(a.id) filter(where a.status='submitted')::int submitted_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='correction' group by s.id

with locked_session as ( select id,user_id,goal_id,rule_version_id,status from cm_learning_session where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type='correction' for update ) select s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,s.status,count(sq.id)::int total_count, count(a.id) filter(where a.status='submitted')::int submitted_count from locked_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' group by s.id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,s.status
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set status='in_progress',started_time=coalesce(started_time,now()),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type='correction' and status='created'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_learning_session(id,user_id,goal_id,session_type,status,rule_version_id,request_id) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},'correction','created',#{ruleVersionId},#{requestId}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select sq.id session_question_id,sq.question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.ai_rubric_snapshot::text ai_rubric_snapshot,s.id session_id,s.user_id,s.goal_id,sq.question_order,s.status session_status, (select count(*) from cm_session_question x where x.session_id=s.id)::int total_count,sq.presentation_snapshot::text,sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text,sq.exam_subject_id,sq.evidence_group_key,sq.difficulty_snapshot,a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text,aa.grading_status,aa.grading_result::text grading_result,case when aa.score_rate is null then null else aa.score_rate=1 end correct from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='correction' and sq.question_order=#{questionOrder}

select * from (select sq.id session_question_id,sq.question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.ai_rubric_snapshot::text ai_rubric_snapshot,sq.question_order,a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text,aa.grading_status,aa.grading_result::text grading_result,case when aa.score_rate is null then null else aa.score_rate=1 end correct from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='correction') x order by question_order
mapper.insert: insert into cm_question_attempt(id,session_question_id,user_id,attempt_no,status,create_request_id,submit_request_id,submitted_time,timer_status,is_blank,is_skipped,is_first_attempt,is_repeat_attempt) values(#{id},#{item.sessionQuestionId},#{item.userId},1,'submitted',#{requestId},#{requestId},now(),'missing',false,false,true,false) on conflict do nothing

insert into cm_attempt_answer(id,attempt_id,answer_data,score,max_score,score_rate,grading_status,graded_time) values(#{id},#{attemptId},#{answerData}::jsonb,case when #{correct} then 1 else 0 end,1,case when #{correct} then 1 else 0 end,'graded',now())
mapper.update: update cm_attempt_answer set score=#{scoreRate}::numeric,max_score=1,score_rate=#{scoreRate}::numeric,grading_status='graded',grading_result=#{result}::jsonb,graded_time=now() where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and grading_status='pending'
update cm_attempt_answer set score=0,max_score=1,score_rate=0,grading_status='failed',grading_result=#{result}::jsonb,graded_time=now() where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and grading_status='pending'
mapper.select: select e.id from cm_error_record e join cm_question_attempt a on a.id=e.attempt_id join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id where e.user_id=#{userId} and e.goal_id=#{goalId} and sq.question_id=#{questionId} and e.status in ('unresolved','correcting') order by e.id for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_correction_record(id,error_record_id,correction_attempt_id,status,score_rate,request_id,submitted_time,settled_time) values(#{id},#{errorRecordId},#{attemptId},'success',1,#{requestId},now(),now()) on conflict(error_record_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_question_attempt a join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id where sq.session_id=#{sessionId} and a.status='submitted'

select count(*) from cm_attempt_answer aa join cm_question_attempt a on a.id=aa.attempt_id join cm_session_question sq on sq.id=a.session_question_id where sq.session_id=#{sessionId} and aa.grading_status in ('pending','processing')
mapper.update: update cm_learning_session set status='submitted',submitted_time=coalesce(submitted_time,now()),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type='correction' and status='in_progress'
update cm_learning_session set status='settling',status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='submitted'

update cm_learning_session set status='completed',settled_time=coalesce(settled_time,now()),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='settling'
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{actionCode} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},#{actionCode},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_id=#{resourceId},response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
